args.title: Fix hourly purge of failed uploads to ensure items are deleted correctly
args.body:
File: src/ingest/worker.ts

This change corrects the logic in the purgeExpiredFailedUploads function to handle access errors properly. Previously, a failure due to AccessDenied would prevent further uploads from being purged, but now the function will log the error and continue processing other items.
